items.item: Audit the entire frontend for unused components
items.description: Scan the frontend/src directory and identify components/pages/hooks that are not imported or used anywhere. This audit will produce a list of candidates for cleanup.

items.description: Review every endpoint in app/api/ and identify which ones are missing input validation, error handling, or auth guards. This review will produce a list of endpoints needing fixes.

items.item: [GRAPH-0.1] Add event_group_id column to health_metrics
items.description: Add nullable UUID/string event_group_id column to health_metrics table. Add index (user_id, event_group_id). Backfill existing rows as null. Update HealthMetricCreate and HealthMetricResponse schemas. Update HealthMetricService.create() and create_batch().

items.item: [GRAPH-0.2] Group multi-metric ingestion events
items.description: Assign event_group_id to grouped metrics: meals (CARBS/FAT/PROTEIN/FIBER/CALORIES), exercise, insulin, sleep, and provider ingestion (Garmin/Fitbit). Preserve provider event/session IDs where stable.

items.item: [GRAPH-0.3] Add same-event graph linking
items.description: Create same_event_as edges between metrics sharing event_group_id. Add link_event_group() helper to graph service. Add dedup tests.

items.item: [GRAPH-2] Extend graph schema with new fields
items.description: Add planned fields to HealthMetricEdge: window_start, window_end, confidence_components, provenance, optional direction. Add relationships to HealthMetric model.

items.item: [GRAPH-3] Schema migrations for new graph fields
items.description: Add event_group_id to health_metrics, provenance_json/confidence_components_json/window_start/window_end to health_metric_edges. Add indexes. Verify SQLite and Postgres compatibility.

items.item: [GRAPH-4] Complete graph service layer methods
items.description: Implement remaining HealthGraphService methods: get_edges_for_metric(), get_recent_correlations(), get_event_group(), link_event_group(), aggregation helpers (edge count by type, avg confidence, strongest recurring pairs).

items.item: [GRAPH-5] Wire remaining pattern detections to graph edges
items.description: Update PatternService to persist: delayed high-fat meal detection, exercise impact detection, overnight low detection, insulin historical relationships, correlation analysis. Make edge-writing optional/configurable.

items.item: [GRAPH-5A] Implement provenance tracking for graph edges
items.description: Add provenance_json to health_metric_edges. Store detector name/version, run type, run ID, feature window. Add provenance helper builders and detector version constants.

items.item: [GRAPH-5B] Implement confidence decomposition
items.description: Add confidence_components_json to edges. Create shared scoring utility with components: repetition, temporal_consistency, effect_size, data_completeness, source_quality, recency. Define RAG wording thresholds (low/medium/high).

items.item: [GRAPH-5C] Design photo meal ingest service contract
items.description: Research visual detectors (FoodSAM, YOLO). Design swappable analyze_meal_image() interface. Define MealImageAnalysisProposal schema. Add validation/clamping. Plan canonical food resolution data model.

items.item: [GRAPH-6] Add event-group query endpoint + auth for graph API
items.description: Add event-group query endpoint. Replace placeholder user_id query pattern with dependency-injected auth for all graph endpoints.

items.item: [GRAPH-7] Harden RAG graph evidence contract
items.description: Ensure RAG retrieves only query-relevant edge types. Cap edges to top 5-10. Suppress weak edges. Ensure safety wording remains observational. Add RAG evidence contract tests.

items.item: [GRAPH-8] Add remaining graph tests
items.description: Write tests for: exercise→drop edge, event grouping, same-event edge dedup, provenance structure, confidence scoring, RAG evidence contract, safety (no dosing advice).

items.item: [GRAPH-9] Update documentation for graph architecture
items.description: Update CONTEXT.md with graph vocabulary. Update ARCHITECTURE_MAP.md with graph data flow. Update CODEBASE_AUDIT.md. Link to PHL/PHKG research reference.

items.item: [GRAPH-10] Review and harden graph layer
items.description: Run full test suite. Check Alembic migration chain. Check circular imports. Check API auth scoping. Check graph-derived copy for safety risks. Produce final implementation summary.
